description: This is a fun LSC with dueling instead of lightsaber combat. It's more of an attempt to use LSC as a platform for dueling, than saying that dueling is the best option for LSC. I need some quick comments, please. Also, there's not supposed to be any V8 cards in here.
strategy:
The basic strategy is: deploy, drain, evade and duel. Civil Disorder (V) is a problem. But if I can get the first drains, so that I am ahead in the race, every force he loses to make a combat card lost, is a step closer to victory for me. I really only have two questions for this deck:

1. Should I replace the The Emperor (V) with another regular Palpatine?

2. I'd really like to have Darth Maul (Tatooine version) in here, for extra dueling and Ability x3 (V). Which card should go out?

Thanks for your comments!
